wo-jpfa-JR4552.d:
Job Summary

The Commercial HH Operator at PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk (CF Lengkong) is responsible for the efficient and safe operation of heavy machinery and equipment within our commercial farming operations. This role focuses on maximizing productivity and maintaining equipment to ensure smooth and effective farm processes.

Job Responsibilities

* Operate and monitor various types of heavy machinery and equipment, including but not limited to, tractors, loaders, excavators, and forklifts, as required for farming activities.
* Perform routine pre-operational checks and basic maintenance on assigned equipment, including fluid levels, tire pressure, and general cleanliness.
* Identify and report any mechanical issues, malfunctions, or safety concerns with equipment to the immediate supervisor.
* Follow all safety protocols and company policies while operating machinery and working on site.
* Assist with loading, unloading, and transporting feed, livestock, and other materials as directed.
* Maintain accurate records of equipment usage, fuel consumption, and maintenance activities.
* Collaborate with other team members to ensure efficient workflow and timely completion of tasks.
* Adhere to production schedules and quality standards set by the farm management.
* Participate in training programs to enhance operational skills and safety awareness.

Job Qualifications

* Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience (at least 2 years) operating heavy machinery in a commercial farming or industrial setting.
* Valid Heavy Equipment Operator License (SIO) specific to the types of machinery operated (e.g., forklift, excavator, loader).
* Strong understanding of heavy equipment mechanics and ability to perform basic troubleshooting.
* Good physical condition and ability to work in various weather conditions.
* Ability to follow instructions accurately and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Commitment to safety and adherence to all operational guidelines.
* Basic literacy and numeracy skills for record-keeping.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as needed.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
